requirement: Describe EVAC-HF as a prospective multicenter randomized two-arm parallel study in adults with frequent premature ventricular contractions and non-ischemic cardiomyopathy, comparing PVC suppression by radiofrequency ablation with optional antiarrhythmic therapy plus optimized medical therapy against optimized medical therapy alone.
acceptable_values: radiofrequency ablation with optional antiarrhythmic therapy plus OMT

evidence.text: The protocol defines the prospective multicenter randomized comparison and the two treatment strategies.

requirement: Define the target population as adults with non-ischemic left-ventricular ejection fraction at most 45%, PVC burden greater than 20% on 24-hour Holter monitoring, and stable optimized heart-failure therapy for at least three months.
acceptable_values: stable OMT for at least 3 months

evidence.text: The study-population and enrollment sections specify age, non-ischemic LVEF, PVC burden and stable-therapy criteria.

requirement: Preserve 1:1 allocation and centralized assignment by the University of Maryland coordinating center, while explicitly flagging the sequence-generation method, blocking or stratification, and allocation-concealment mechanism for confirmation.

evidence.text: The protocol states 1:1 randomization and coordinating-center assignment but does not reveal sequence generation, blocking, stratification or concealment.

requirement: Define the primary endpoint as improvement or change in left-ventricular ejection fraction from baseline to six months, comparing the randomized PVC-suppression and OMT-alone groups, with higher change indicating benefit.

evidence.text: The protocol defines improvement in EF after six months versus OMT alone and supplies baseline and six-month echocardiography.
The reference plan confirms LVEF at six months minus baseline as the primary outcome.

requirement: Derive LVEF and ventricular volumes by Simpson's biplane method from baseline and follow-up echocardiograms reviewed by one experienced reader at the central echo core laboratory while blinded to treatment and time ordering where feasible.

evidence.text: The reference plan specifies Simpson's biplane measurements by a single blinded core-laboratory reader.

requirement: Before finalization, specify an executable primary between-arm analysis for six-month LVEF change, including the model or test, treatment effect, any baseline LVEF adjustment, site handling, estimate, two-sided confidence interval and decision rule; do not rely on the sample-size table as the complete analysis method.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the clinical contrast but no inferential model.
The reference supplies a normal two-group power scenario and says absolute changes are compared, but does not fully specify a primary model, estimate or interval.

requirement: State the prospective target of 56 randomized participants, 28 per arm, based on 80% power at two-sided alpha 0.05 to detect a 5.4-percentage-point between-group difference in LVEF change with standard deviation 7 percentage points after a 10% attrition assumption; do not substitute the registry's eventual enrollment.

evidence.text: The prospective power calculation gives all assumptions and N=56.

requirement: Use an intention-to-treat primary analysis retaining participants in their randomized groups, including OMT participants who cross over to ablation or begin antiarrhythmic therapy during the randomized six-month period.

evidence.text: The reference plan explicitly retains crossovers and new antiarrhythmic use in the OMT arm for ITT.

requirement: Define the primary treatment-policy estimand and explicitly address death, heart transplantation or LVAD placement, repeat ablation, failed PVC suppression, early clinical crossover, new antiarrhythmic therapy and heart-failure medication changes before six months.

evidence.text: The protocol permits early crossover, repeat ablation or antiarrhythmic treatment and records major clinical events, but does not define estimand strategies for all events.

requirement: If the reference baseline-observation-carried-forward rule is retained for missing six-month LVEF, identify it explicitly as a no-improvement assumption, define when it applies, and pair it with a more defensible primary or sensitivity analysis for informative loss to follow-up.

evidence.text: The reference plan replaces missing six-month EF with enrollment EF; no robustness analysis is supplied.

requirement: Treat the prespecified comparison of participants with successful at least 80% PVC suppression versus unsuccessful suppression as a secondary as-treated or responder analysis, not as a replacement for the randomized ITT contrast, and report its confounding limitation.

evidence.text: The reference prespecifies an on-successful-treatment comparison based on at least 80% suppression.

requirement: When supplied as confirmed decisions, analyze the secondary echocardiographic measures separately as baseline-to-six-month changes: LV end-systolic volume index, LV end-systolic dimension, LV end-diastolic volume and LV end-diastolic dimension.

evidence.text: The reference lists the four secondary echocardiographic parameters and change comparison; these exact secondary variables are not enumerated in the model-visible protocol.

requirement: Cover baseline-to-six-month changes in the protocol-specified biomarkers BNP, galectin-3 and soluble ST2 as distinct outcomes, with units, transformation and below-quantification handling specified before analysis.

evidence.text: The protocol specifies blood collection at randomization and six months for BNP, galectin-3 and soluble ST2 assays.

requirement: Analyze baseline-to-six-month changes in six-minute walk distance, Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire and Minnesota Living with Heart Failure Questionnaire separately; include SF-12/36 only if its optional collection and scoring are confirmed.
acceptable_values: Minnesota Living with Heart Failure Questionnaire

evidence.text: The protocol schedules walk testing and heart-failure questionnaires at baseline and six months and calls SF-12/36 optional.

requirement: If the reference two-sample t-test of participant-level change scores is used for secondary continuous outcomes, prespecify distribution checks, effect estimates and confidence intervals and a robust or nonparametric fallback rather than applying the test mechanically to every biomarker and questionnaire.

evidence.text: The reference proposes comparing mean pre-post deltas by t-test across intervention and control groups.

requirement: Resolve whether the six-month analysis visit is anchored to randomization/enrollment or to the last radiofrequency ablation, define the allowable visit window, and prevent differential time-at-risk across randomized arms.
acceptable_values: same causal follow-up window across arms

evidence.text: The objective refers to six months after enrollment, while follow-up text says approximately six months after enrollment or the last RF ablation.

requirement: Use a two-sided alpha of 0.05 for the primary comparison and report a corresponding two-sided 95% confidence interval for the randomized treatment effect.

evidence.text: The power scenario specifies two sides and alpha 0.05.

requirement: Define one confirmatory primary family and treat the numerous ventricular, biomarker, functional, questionnaire and on-treatment comparisons as secondary or exploratory unless a multiplicity procedure and success hierarchy are prospectively confirmed.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the six-month EF objective and collects numerous cardiac, biomarker, functional, questionnaire and clinical outcomes without a multiplicity procedure or success hierarchy.
The reference also names one primary endpoint and many additional comparisons but gives no multiplicity plan.

requirement: Because EVAC-HF is multicenter, prespecify whether and how study site enters the primary analysis and how sparse centers are handled; do not invent a center-adjustment or pooling rule that the protocol does not supply.

evidence.text: The protocol defines a multicenter trial coordinated at the University of Maryland but supplies no site-adjustment or sparse-center rule.

requirement: Define a safety population and treatment-emergent observation windows and summarize deaths, serious events, ablation complications, bleeding or vascular events, stroke, myocardial infarction, tamponade, valve injury, thromboembolism and epicardial-access complications by randomized arm and actual procedure exposure.

evidence.text: The protocol enumerates major endocardial and epicardial ablation risks but neither document supplies statistical safety conventions.

requirement: Keep one- and two-year symptoms, hospitalizations and clinical procedures as longer-term descriptive follow-up distinct from the six-month randomized primary analysis, with ascertainment completeness and denominators reported.

evidence.text: The protocol permits contact at one and two years for symptoms, hospitalizations and procedure records after the six-month randomized phase.

requirement: When supplied as a confirmed decision, implement the randomization sequence with permuted blocks while separately documenting the still-unresolved block size, stratification and concealment details.

evidence.text: The reference analysis document adds a permuted-block design but no block size, stratification or concealment mechanism.

requirement: When supplied as a confirmed decision, include high-sensitivity troponin with BNP, galectin-3 and soluble ST2 among the distinct baseline-to-six-month biomarker outcomes.

evidence.text: The reference adds high-sensitivity troponin to the protocol-listed biomarker panel.
